newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - CHINESE NEWSPAPERS - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - CHINESE NEWSPAPERS - AUG 12.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Front page report hails remarkable economic growth in Shanghai over the past five years, saying gross domestic product has climbed an average of 14 percent each year.
- Analytical article says variations on public ownership should be explored to boost productive forces.
- China imported 45,000 tonnes of wool from New Zealand between 1996 and 1997.
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- Hainan province recovers from the collapse of its bubble economy in the early 1990s and enjoys stable, sustained growth over the past two years.
- Development of promising township enterprises in Ningxia region benefits the local economy.
- Some 200,000 laid-off workers from state firms in Fujian province found new jobs in the past two years with the assistance of local governments.
CHINA SECURITIES
- State Statistical Bureau figures show heavy industry replacing light industry as the leading sector in the 1991-1996 period.
- Gao Jian, chief of the Finance Ministry's Bond Department calls for market forces to be further applied in China's bond markets.
ECONOMIC DAILY
- About 300 enterprises entered the Three Gorges Comprehensive Market Network in the first half of 1997, with total investment reaching 200 million yuan.
FINANCIAL NEWS
- Experts from the Securities Commission of the State Council and the China Securities Regulatory Commission predict China's stock markets will rise in a stable way in the second half of the year.
- New stock market accounts increased rapidly in Beijing after required deposits were reduced on August 4.
- Handan Iron and Steel Group made a post-tax profit of 220 million yuan in the first half of 1997.
- General deposits at the Construction Bank of China rose 30 percent year-on-year in the first half of the year, to 1,200 billion yuan, with post-tax profits reaching 2.7 billion yuan.
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- Sino-Italian aluminium foil joint venture opens in the southwestern province of Sichuan.
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- Mechanical and electrical product exports in Gansu province earn $28.24 in foreign exchange during the first half of 1997, up 68 percent year-on-year.
CHINA DAILY

- A stable Sino-U.S. relationship is in the best interest of China, the United States and the world, Liu Huaqiu, director of the State Council's Foreign Affairs Office, tells visiting U.S. National Security Advisor Sandy Berger.
- Government officials and foreign experts approve guideline for alleviating effects of natural disasters.
-- The Chinese Academy of Sciences is determined to open more of its research posts to Chinese scholars around the world.
-- Director of the Xinhua News Agency Hong Kong branch, Jiang Enzhu, promised on Monday to cooperate with the Special Administrative Region government.
